glossary.definition: (1) "Acquiring party" means any person by whom or on whose behalf a merger or other acquisition of control is to be effected.
glossary.source_title: Section 3901.321 - Mergers and acquisitions of domestic insurers.

glossary.definition: (2) "Domestic insurer" includes any person controlling a domestic insurer unless the person, as determined by the superintendent of insurance, is either directly or through its affiliates primarily engaged in business other than the business of insurance.
glossary.source_title: Section 3901.321 - Mergers and acquisitions of domestic insurers.
